story.title: Oklahoma State rewards Eric Morris with contract extension after Cowboys' dramatic turnaround
story.summary: Morris will get a fresh six-year deal that adds two more years and a big raise amid a successful first year in Stillwater Oklahoma State has undergone one of the biggest turnarounds in college football this season, as Eric Morris has led the Cowboys to a 7-4 record entering the final week, already a six-win improvement over last year's 1-11 disaster in Stillwater. As a reward for that swift turnaround, the Pokes are giving Morris a fresh six-year deal, according to multiple reports. It includes a pay raise and extends his contract for two additional years through 2032, per ESPN . Morris signed a 5-year, $20 million deal last year, and his new contract is reportedly worth more than $31.5 million over the next six years.
